sam: Quick note — TamaInt4 candidate (tamarind-int4-2026-03) ran a small AB against stable (tamarind-2.1) on long-doc (>600 tokens) and multieval slices. Early signal: cost down ~28% median latency down ~10% but p99 up and a quality delta on 'citation' and 'code-exec' slices. Proposed rollout: sliding 3-step ramp (0.25%, 1%, 5%) with Bayesian-smoothed triggers, persistence=2 windows (30m sliding), exponential backoff on flaps, kv-warm probe at each step, shadow-compare enabled for 2k requests. Full trigger set below.

noor: paste the AB tables? need n, conf intervals, and whether we used control variates.

devon: AB snapshot (last 4h sample, long-doc slice): n=3,800; baseline MRR=0.667 (95% CI 0.660-0.674), candidate MRR=0.661 (0.654-0.668) => abs drop 0.006 (-0.9% rel). Halluc proxy (LM-answer mismatch): baseline 1.8% -> candidate 2.9% (+1.1pp). p99 latency baseline 480ms -> candidate 605ms (+26% rel). cost tok/unit -27% median.

sam: ok. Proposed trigger thresholds (sliding window semantics):
```json
{
  "window_minutes": 30,
  "stages": [0.25, 1, 5],
  "persistence_windows": 2,
  "bayesian_alpha": 1.0,
  "triggers": {
    "mrr_abs_drop": 0.0075,
    "hallucination_pp_delta": 0.012,
    "p99_latency_rel": 0.20,
    "code-exec-failure_rate": 0.003
  },
  "backoff": {"min_minutes":15, "factor":2},
  "kv_warm_probe": {"enabled":true, "sample_size":200}
}
```

noor: +1 to bayesian smoothing and sliding window. Suggest we also ignore top-0.5% largest payloads to avoid noisy outliers.

devon: canary-bot: [info] Canary tamarind-int4 @ 0.25% started at 2026-03-21T14:02:11Z. shadow_compare=enabled.

canary-bot: [alert] Auto-fallback triggered for tamarind-int4 -> fallback to tamarind-2.1 at 2026-03-21T14:17:29Z due to triggers: p99_rel (0.26) & halluc_delta (0.011). snapshot_id=snap-r7f3a. Actions: shift_traffic 100% -> tamarind-2.1, start cooldown 30m, retain_shadow_diff=2000.

sam: Good catch. Next steps: (1) run focused long-doc sweep with kv-warm and prefix caching enabled, (2) run targeted code-exec slice tests with increased sample size (5k), (3) prototype adjusted kernel scheduling to reduce p99. Will open PR for the canary config + runbook.
